method: Offline disassembly of the installed executable, source inspection and reduced selection replay. No process memory access or running-game interaction.

native_evidence.behavior: The division designer obtains its selectable models through the template method at 0xb9f560, which calls 0x192c7b0.
With multiple candidates and no matching explicit override, the preview uses option index 1, after USE_DEFAULT_MODEL. With no selectable models it instead calls 0x192c4c0.
Collects both domestic available equipment and the foreign equipment collection from the country production object.
Equipment comparison groups by archetype registration index, then descending parent depth and variant version; otherwise matching the player country precedes foreign origin.
Type conversion maps infantry to 0x20 and mechanized to 0x10.
Starts with template country. If equipment does not have the infantry bit and its type mask equals the sub-unit type mask, substitutes equipment origin (or creator if origin is absent).
Queries graphic_db using the country selected by the caller. Ideology and culture filter data come from the equipment creator.
Visual technology level sums visual_tech_level_addition through the parent chain and is clamped to at least 1; it is distinct from visual_level and production priority.
Without a sub-unit priority override, ordinary candidate priority is (battalion_count * 100 + 10 + equipment_visual_technology_level) * 10. Explicit equipment model overrides have separate priority.
Already encountered model entity names are skipped before priority insertion; a later query cannot upgrade their priority.
The outer queue uses the computed candidate priority multiplied by 100000. Graphic pool weight is not added to that queue key. Equal keys are inserted before existing keys.

source_contract.carrier_aliases: Country/cosmetic mechanized aliases resolve to their own national APC root.
source_contract.designer_pool: The national APC root entity is introduced only by the infantry_equipment query, restricted to the mechanized battalion.
source_contract.nod: NOD has its own six-wheel APC mesh, national infantry escort, country/cosmetic motorized and mechanized aliases, and a rifle-only designer pool. The routes do not depend on human or AI control.

reduced_replay.scope: Automatic preview of one mechanized battalion with domestic and foreign carrier-2163 designs, followed by rifle-2156 or rifle-2163 queries. No excluded equipment or explicit model override.
reduced_replay.without_pools: The foreign carrier model can precede the domestic model on equal priority; later rifle queries deduplicate the same legacy entity names.
reduced_replay.same_root_in_rifle_and_carrier_pools: The root entity is already consumed by the carrier query and cannot acquire the later rifle priority.
reduced_replay.rifle_only_pool: The national root is a new candidate with priority 1120 or 1130, exceeding the carrier aliases at 1110.

limitations: The replay isolates the relevant ordering and deduplication branch; it does not execute the complete native loader or renderer.
These priorities establish selection for the stated equipment combination, not every combination of later imported IFVs and early rifles.
A manually selected division model is intentionally not overridden.
A cold start and fresh division-designer observation are still required for rendered-game confirmation.
